description: Grafana Dashboard for Prometheus metrics exposed by authentik.

panels.description: Workers running a different version than the server.

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, version) (authentik_tasks_workers{namespace=~"$namespace", version_matched="False"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Outdated workers

panels.description: Outpost instances with at least one open websocket connection to authentik.

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, outpost, uid) (authentik_outposts_connected{namespace=~"$namespace"}) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Outposts connected

panels.description: Time until the enterprise license expires.
panels.title: License expires in

panels.description: Days until each certificate expires. Negative means already expired.
panels.title: Certificate expiry

panels.description: Time since each outpost last reported to authentik.
panels.title: Outpost last update

panels.description: Time spent in the authentik core, grouped by the Django app (URL namespace) that handled the request.
panels.title: Request latency by app (p95)

panels.description: Total time the policy engine took to evaluate all bindings of an object.
panels.title: Policy engine time (p95)

panels.description: Execution time of individual policies, users and groups bound to objects.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, binding_target_type, binding_target_name, mode) (rate(authentik_policies_execution_time_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Policy execution time (p95, top 10)

panels.description: Time LDAP and RADIUS outposts spend executing authentication flows against authentik.
panels.title: Flow executor time (p95)
